title: Grimhollow Village
description: Haunted hamlet on the edge of the northeastern swamp, where the living and the dead keep the same hours. Madame Hex has foreseen a boss fight, as she does for everyone. Mort keeps the shop because being dead is good for overhead. Wednesday can see your save file.

steps.text: Grimhollow sat at the edge of the northeastern swamp, where the fog came in every evening and the town had long since stopped arguing with it. The living and the dead kept the same hours here. Nobody remembered agreeing to that. It had simply been easier than the alternative.

lines.speaker: Madame Hex
lines.text: Ah. Travelers. I saw you coming.

lines.speaker: Madame Hex
lines.text: I see everyone coming. It is a small town and I have a window.

lines.speaker: Madame Hex
lines.text: But I also see your future, and for once I will tell it for free: there is a dragon in the dark to the northeast, and it will be a BOSS FIGHT.

lines.speaker: Madame Hex
lines.text: ...It is always a boss fight. Fifty gold if you want to know the element.

lines.speaker: Undead Shopkeeper Mort
lines.text: Nobody leaves and nobody quite dies. It does wonders for the census.

lines.speaker: Undead Shopkeeper Mort
lines.text: I keep the shop. I used to adventure. You can see how that went. Buy a potion; it is the one investment I would make again.

lines.speaker: Creepy Child Wednesday
lines.text: You have a save file. I can see it from here.

lines.speaker: Creepy Child Wednesday
lines.text: It is very small. You have not done very much yet.

lines.speaker: Creepy Child Wednesday
lines.text: That's all right. Files grow. Mine stopped, but yours will grow.
